Good afternoon,

I am performing the User Specified Models with SNP Effects analysis for a rat population but it is taking quite a long time given the number of markers I am testing. Is it possible to perform this analysis by chromosome?

Best,

Joel

messages.author: d6d83e22ef3ba9f1
messages.subject: Re: analysis by chromosome
parts:
Hi Joel, 

Just to clarify, you are running the userGWAS function? Each run for the GWAS functions are independent of one another, so you can split it up however you like without issue (by SNP, in batches of 50k, etc.). 

Best, 
  Andrew
